title: Planting Trees in the Neighborhood
paragraphs: Menyadari betapa gersang dan panasnya jalan utama di lingkungannya pada sore musim panas, Faiz mengusulkan proyek penanaman pohon komunitas kepada perkumpulan warga setempat musim semi lalu.
Beberapa tetangga awalnya skeptis, mempertanyakan apakah ada yang benar-benar akan merawat pohon-pohon muda itu dengan baik setelah antusiasme awal hari penanaman pasti memudar.
Faiz mengatur jadwal penyiraman bergilir sederhana di antara para relawan, menangani kekhawatiran ini secara langsung alih-alih mengabaikannya sebagai masalah yang tidak mungkin benar-benar terjadi.

Dua tahun kemudian, pohon-pohon muda itu kini memberikan keteduhan nyata di sepanjang jalan, dan tetangga yang dulu ragu kini secara rutin berterima kasih kepada Faiz karena mendorong ide itu meski ada keraguan awal.
answerKey: Noticing how bare and hot the main street in his neighborhood felt during summer afternoons, Faiz proposed a community tree-planting project to his local residents' association last spring. Some neighbors were skeptical at first, questioning whether anyone would actually maintain the young trees properly once the initial enthusiasm of planting day inevitably faded away. Faiz organized a simple rotating watering schedule among volunteers, addressing this exact concern directly rather than dismissing it as an unlikely problem that would not actually occur. Two years later, the young trees now provide real shade along the street, and neighbors who once doubted the project now regularly thank Faiz for pushing the idea forward despite early skepticism.
